one_line: NVIDIA expands open models in Europe as Mistral and OpenAI launch new AI tools; AI patches web flaws

themes.title: NVIDIA open models grow in Europe
themes.text: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 and Kumo models for European industries and saw its open‑weight models integrated into public‑sector projects, weather‑forecasting initiatives, and retailer AI pipelines, delivering cost and performance gains.

stories.headline: NVIDIA launches open Nemotron 3.5 and Kumo models for European industries
NVIDIA open models adopted in European public sector projects
European firms adopt NVIDIA Earth‑2 models for weather and climate forecasting
European retailers cut inference costs up to 90% using NVIDIA open models

themes.title: Mistral AI unveils new multimodal tools
themes.text: Mistral AI previewed the 1‑trillion‑parameter Mistral Large 4 model, launched the Voxtral 3 voice‑agent SDK with multilingual speech models, and partnered with Mozilla to power the Firefox Smart Window browsing assistant.

stories.headline: Mistral AI opens preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1‑trillion‑parameter multimodal model
Mistral AI releases Voxtral 3 voice agent SDK with multilingual speech models
Mistral and Mozilla launch AI‑powered Firefox Smart Window beta

themes.title: OpenAI models enter Google Cloud
themes.text: OpenAI added its frontier models and Codex workflows to Google Cloud’s Marketplace and announced private‑preview access to GPT‑6 and GPT‑6.1 models for select enterprise customers.

stories.headline: OpenAI models and Codex workflows added to Google Cloud Marketplace
OpenAI’s GPT‑6, 6.1 models to be available on Google Cloud

themes.title: AI tools expose critical PHP flaws
themes.text: AI systems from OpenAI and Google’s Wiz identified two critical PHP vulnerabilities affecting up to 70 % of websites, prompting patches from the PHP Foundation.

stories.headline: AI tools uncover critical PHP vulnerabilities affecting up to 70% of websites
